newsitem.title: USA: Edison joins electric battery consortium.
newsitem.headline: Edison joins electric battery consortium.

text.p: Edison EV, a unit of Edison International, said Thursday it is participating through the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) in the United States Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC).
"Improved batteries are the key to getting more electric vehicles on the road," explained Edison EV president Diane Wittenberg.

Launched in 1991, the USABC is a partnership among the Big Three domestic automakers, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) and a group led by EPRI to develop advanced battery systems that will provide increased range and improved electric vehicle performance.

In October 1996, DOE announced a $106-million agreement with the USABC for a second phase of research to continue reducing the costs of mid-term electric vehicle batteries and develop long-term battery technologies.
